changes.original: Valid key patterns include alphanumeric characters, underscores, and percent-encoded characters.
changes.appended: Additional public runtime context: re (the Python regular-expression module), unquote (urllib.parse.unquote), and valid_key_pattern (a supplied compiled re.Pattern[str]) are available in the execution namespace. valid_key_pattern.match(text) applies the key-name character policy described above. These are external runtime dependencies; use the supplied bindings rather than replacing them with locally invented values.

changes.original: A Patient class is available, containing fields like name, age, gender, diagnosis, and treatment_plan, which represent various patient details.
changes.appended: Additional public runtime context: patients is a supplied mapping from patient identifier strings to existing Patient objects. It is available in the execution namespace alongside Patient. Resolve the requested patient through this mapping; the caller supplies the records. Do not create a replacement registry, instantiate substitute records, or overwrite the supplied patients binding. The existing public return, exception, template and confidentiality requirements remain in effect.
